funders.name: Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health (ARPA-H) / NIH
funders.agent_search_hints: Check ARPA-H Open BAA for broad mission areas and NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts filtering by AI.

funders.name: Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA)
funders.agent_search_hints: Search SAM.gov for DARPA BAAs (especially I2O, DSO, STO). AIE solicitations have fast 90-day turnaround windows.

funders.name: Department of Energy (DOE) - Office of Science
funders.agent_search_hints: Check Advanced Scientific Computing Research (ASCR) program announcements on OSTI.gov.

funders.name: European Commission - Horizon Europe
funders.agent_search_hints: Search EU Funding & Tenders Portal filtering by Framework Programme: Horizon Europe and Cluster 4 (HORIZON-CL4).

funders.name: National Science Foundation (NSF)
funders.agent_search_hints: Filter solicitations by keywords "Artificial Intelligence" or "CISE". Check Dear Colleague Letters (DCLs) for supplements.

funders.name: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)
funders.agent_search_hints: Look for Administration for Community Living (ACL) and CDC challenges related to AI assistive tools.

funders.name: Amazon Science
funders.agent_search_hints: Runs twice a year (Spring & Fall). Awards unrestricted cash gifts (up to $80K) plus AWS promotional credits ($20K-$40K).

funders.name: Anthropic
funders.agent_search_hints: Anthropic Fellows Program funds researchers directly working with technical safety teams.

funders.name: Ethereum Foundation (Ecosystem Support Program)
funders.agent_search_hints: ESP operates rolling grants and project-based travel support for core protocol and cryptographic researchers. Use ESP Office Hours for fast proposal alignment.

funders.name: Google Research & Google DeepMind
funders.agent_search_hints: Monitor Google Research Outreach page for seasonal RFPs (typically unrestricted gifts to universities).

funders.name: Google.org
active_programs_sample: Google.org Impact Challenge: AI for Science
funders.agent_search_hints: Impact Challenges offer $500K-$3M in funding alongside Google technical fellowship support.

funders.name: Meta AI
funders.agent_search_hints: Look for Llama ecosystem grants supporting open-weights innovation and academic RFPs on research.facebook.com.

funders.name: Microsoft Research
funders.agent_search_hints: Look for university nomination requirements for fellowships and open RFPs for Azure AI compute credits.

funders.name: OpenAI
funders.agent_search_hints: Researcher Access Program grants $1K-$5K in API credits on rolling cycles; check OpenAI blog announcements for dedicated grant RFPs.

funders.name: Reid Hoffman Foundation / Aphorism Foundation
funders.agent_search_hints: Check Lever for Change open challenges funded by Reid Hoffman and Stanford HAI partnerships.

funders.name: Stripe & Frontier Climate
funders.agent_search_hints: Frontier provides non-dilutive offtake purchase agreements and research funding for deep tech.

funders.name: Alfred P. Sloan Foundation
funders.agent_search_hints: Sloan Research Fellowships deadline is typically September; digital technology grants review Letters of Inquiry year-round.

funders.name: Bezos Earth Fund
active_programs_sample: AI for Climate and Nature Grand Challenges ($100M initiative)
funders.agent_search_hints: Funds large institutional initiatives and open calls addressing planetary challenges using AI.

funders.name: Future of Life Institute (FLI)
funders.agent_search_hints: Periodically launches targeted grant competitions with budgets ranging $100K to $1M+ for beneficial AI.

funders.name: Manifund
funders.agent_search_hints: Regrantor model allows individual regrantors to allocate $2K-$50K rapidly without institutional overhead. Acts as fiscal sponsor.

funders.name: Mozilla Foundation
funders.agent_search_hints: MTF awards ~$50K to open-source prototypes; check the Fluxx application portal for open cohorts.

funders.name: Open Philanthropy
active_programs_sample: Early Career AI Safety Researcher Support
funders.agent_search_hints: Median grant ~$257K. Both scheduled RFPs and ongoing investigative grantmaking. Check grant database for historical funding.

funders.name: Quỹ Đổi mới sáng tạo Vingroup (VinIF)
focus_areas: Khoa học công nghệ trọng điểm
Mật mã học & An toàn thông tin
Toán học & Tính toán lượng tử
Hỗ trợ đại biểu quốc tế
active_programs_sample: Tài trợ tham dự hội nghị / hội thảo quốc tế
Học bổng Thạc sĩ / Tiến sĩ VinIF
Câu lạc bộ tài năng nghiên cứu khoa học
funders.agent_search_hints: Hỗ trợ tài chính (lên đến 50–100 triệu VNĐ) cho nhà nghiên cứu trẻ Việt Nam có thư mời báo cáo/tham dự hội nghị khoa học quốc tế uy tín. Nộp qua scholarship@vinif.org hoặc oms.vinif.org.

funders.name: Survival and Flourishing Fund (SFF)
funders.agent_search_hints: Apply for Speculation Grants ($10K-$150K) on a rolling basis; securing one unlocks participation in full annual S-Process rounds.

funders.name: The Rockefeller Foundation
funders.agent_search_hints: Bellagio Center offers prestigious fully funded residencies for scholars and practitioners in Italy.

funders.name: Transformative AI Fund (EA Funds)
active_programs_sample: Transformative AI Grants (Replaced Long-Term Future Fund)
funders.agent_search_hints: Successor to Long-Term Future Fund (LTFF). Fast turnaround, rolling applications, median $25K-$50K for projects, travel, and stipends.

funders.name: 500 Global
funders.agent_search_hints: Global accelerator providing $150K for 6% equity on rolling application windows.

funders.name: ARC Prize (Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus)
funders.agent_search_hints: $1M+ prize pool for open-source AI models cracking novel abstract visual logic tasks.

funders.name: International Association for Cryptologic Research (IACR)
funders.agent_search_hints: Provides travel stipends ($1,000–$2,500) for students and researchers to present or attend flagship conferences (Crypto, Eurocrypt, Asiacrypt, PQCrypto).

funders.name: Jump Trading (Conference Travel Grants)
funders.agent_search_hints: Full travel grants covering flight tickets, lodging, visa fees, and daily meal stipends ($1,000–$10,000) for top STEM students attending major research conferences.

funders.name: Kaggle Competitions & Community Grants
funders.agent_search_hints: Check featured and research competition tracks for sponsored prize pools ($50K-$1M).

funders.name: Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) Competitions
funders.agent_search_hints: Competitions announced annually in spring; winners receive substantial monetary prizes and travel grants.

funders.name: Plug and Play Tech Center
funders.agent_search_hints: Often operates state/city-backed innovation hubs with non-dilutive pilot opportunities and corporate sponsors.

funders.name: XPRIZE Foundation
funders.agent_search_hints: Multi-million dollar competitions with milestone prizes along the trajectory.

funders.name: Y Combinator
active_programs_sample: YC Winter & Summer Batches ($500K standard deal)
funders.agent_search_hints: Check Requests for Startups (RFS) for specific AI verticals YC is eager to fund.

funders.name: AWS Cloud Credit for Research
funders.agent_search_hints: Awards promotional credits ranging $5,000 to $50,000+ for projects demonstrating proof of concept on AWS.

funders.name: NSF ACCESS (Advanced Cyberinfrastructure)
funders.agent_search_hints: Primary US academic supercomputer allocation. Explore track requires no formal proposal for rapid compute.

funders.name: NVIDIA Research & NVAITC
funders.agent_search_hints: Provides physical GPUs (e.g. A100, H100 workstation/servers), DGX Cloud credits, and cash awards.

funders.name: Cyclotron Road / Lawrence Berkeley National Lab
active_programs_sample: Cyclotron Road Fellowship ($500K+ value per fellow)
funders.agent_search_hints: Provides two-year fellowship stipends, health benefits, travel, and world-class laboratory facility access at Berkeley Lab.

funders.name: NSF Major Research Instrumentation (MRI)
funders.agent_search_hints: Institutional submission limits apply (max 4 proposals per university). Submission window mid-October to mid-November.

funders.name: Governance of Artificial Intelligence (GovAI)
funders.agent_search_hints: Stipended fellowships located in Oxford or remote for in-depth AI policy and governance studies.

funders.name: Harvard University - Berkman Klein Center for Internet & Society
funders.agent_search_hints: Annual fellowship application window closes in late autumn for the subsequent academic year.

funders.name: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS)
funders.agent_search_hints: Offers 3-6 month fellowships with competitive stipends supporting policy research.

funders.name: ML Alignment & Theory Scholars (MATS)
funders.agent_search_hints: Provides full stipends, compute resources, and housing in Berkeley alongside leading safety mentors.

funders.name: Mila - Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute
funders.agent_search_hints: Check Mila AI4Humanity and policy pages for international visiting scholar and fellow calls.

funders.name: Princeton Center for Information Technology Policy (CITP)
funders.agent_search_hints: Posts fellowship openings in early winter for academic year appointments.

funders.name: Stanford University (AIMI & Center for Digital Health)
funders.agent_search_hints: AIMI awards annual seed grants up to $100K for interdisciplinary AI-in-medicine investigations.

funders.name: The House Fund / UC Berkeley BAIR
funders.agent_search_hints: Non-dilutive grants awarded directly to Berkeley AI research projects exploring startup potential.

funders.name: Partnership on AI (PAI)
active_programs_sample: Rapid Response Grant Program (with Notre Dame)
funders.agent_search_hints: Funds partner institutions and civil society organizations participating in multi-stakeholder research.

funders.name: Gitcoin Grants
funders.agent_search_hints: Community-driven matching pools using Quadratic Funding. Projects receive community donations matched by sponsor treasuries.

funders.name: IEEE (Computational Intelligence & Industry Applications Societies)
active_programs_sample: EPICS in IEEE Call for Proposals
funders.agent_search_hints: Annual deadlines in spring/fall for graduate research and humanitarian engineering community pilots.

funders.name: Kyber Network & Vietnam Web3 Innovation Grants
funders.agent_search_hints: Hỗ trợ tài năng trẻ Việt Nam trong lĩnh vực blockchain và mật mã học tham gia các vũ đài và hội thảo công nghệ toàn cầu.

funders.name: Open Technology Fund (OTF)
funders.agent_search_hints: Year-round rolling submissions via 2-stage concept note. Focuses on open-source code and public deliverables.

funders.name: ResearchHub Foundation
funders.agent_search_hints: Micro-grants and bounties awarded directly for answering research questions, replicating papers, or peer review.

funders.name: The Linux Foundation & CNCF
funders.agent_search_hints: Monitor training/scholarship pages and CNCF grant guidelines for community travel and maintenance funds.
